test_title: PYST 34: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

The new smartphone had a (1) ________ design, responsive (2) ________, and impressive camera, making it one of the most (3) ________ gadgets in the market.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes the features of the new smartphone, emphasizing its design, interface, and overall popularity.
 
• The word "**sleek**" fits correctly in the first blank as it describes a stylish and attractive design.
 
• The word "**interface**" is suitable for the second blank, referring to the responsive system or user interface of the smartphone.
 
• The term "**sought-after**" is appropriate for the third blank as it highlights the smartphone's desirability in the market.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The new smartphone had a sleek__ design, responsive __interface__, and impressive camera, making it one of the most __sought-after__ gadgets in the market.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sleek:** stylish, smooth, and attractive in appearance.
 
• **Interface:** the user system or interaction features of a device.
 
• **Sought-after:** highly desired or in demand.
